simple.summary: עֶמְדָּה (ʻemdâh) means a station , i.e. domicile First listed occurrence: Mic 1 11.

definitions.full: H5979. emdah [ עֶמְדָּה ] noun feminine standing-ground ; — suffix עֶמְדָּתוֺ מִכֶּם יִקַּח Micah 1:11 ; text dubious see Now.
